description: Personal or studio portfolio site — for individuals/creatives showcasing work rather than selling a product.

default_sections.purpose: Name/title + one-line description of what they do
default_sections.fill_guidance: Keep it short and personal, not sales-oriented like the landing-page hero.
Grid or list of project/work items. Use generic placeholder project names/descriptions matching the stated field (e.g. photography → shoot titles).
Short bio paragraph, first person or third person depending on tone cues in the prompt.
Simple contact form or contact details section, no pricing/CTA-heavy language.
Work, About, Contact — adjust labels to match actual section purposes present.

notes: No pricing or testimonials section by default — portfolios are rarely e-commerce/sales pages. Only add pricing if the prompt explicitly mentions rates/booking.
Visual density/style (grid vs list gallery) should come from an image reference (Mode 1/hybrid) when available; default to a simple grid otherwise.
